questions.question:
There is an error in the given sentence. From the options given, identify the sentence that corrects the error to make it a grammatically accurate sentence.

Harmit is not innocent such as Uday.

options.text: Harmit is not as much as innocent as Uday.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'D'' i.e. "Harmit is not as innocent as Uday." which corrects the error and makes the sentence grammatically accurate..

__
 
• The correct structure for making comparisons of equality is "as + adjective + as".

questions.question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

‘Vande Mataram’, a poignant poem, is obviously and indisputebly the premier national song of India.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Indisputebly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Indisputebly"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "Indisputably" which means something that cannot be disputed or questioned. (निर्विवाद रूप से)

 
 
• **Example: **It is indisputably true that exercise is good for health.
 
 
 
• **"Premier"** means first in importance, order, or position; leading. (प्रधान)
 
 
• **Example: **He is one of the premier scientists in the field of genetics.
 
 
 
• **"Poignant"** means evoking a keen sense of sadness or regret. (मर्मस्पर्शी)
 
 
• **Example: **The movie's poignant ending left the audience in tears.
 
 
 
• **"Obviously"** means in a way that is easily perceived or understood; clearly. (स्पष्ट रूप से)
 
 
• **Example: **She was obviously upset after hearing the bad news.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Indisputebly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Premier** (प्रधान): First in importance, order, or position; leading.

 
 
• **Example:** He is one of the premier scientists in the field of genetics.
 
 
 
• **Poignant** (मर्मस्पर्शी): Evoking a keen sense of sadness or regret.
 
 
• **Example:** The movie's poignant ending left the audience in tears.
 
 
 
• **Obviously** (स्पष्ट रूप से): In a way that is easily perceived or understood; clearly.
 
 
• **Example:** She was obviously upset after hearing the bad news.
